title: Fae Roads Refuse Fire: First Pressure
description: Fae Roads Refuse Fire unfolds across fae crossing where mirrored dew paths repeat careless movement, pushing a 5-Titan Tuatha squad to prove adaptation, healing, roots, terrain control, endurance through life systems. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Fae Roads Refuse Fire: First Pressure advances Roots Below the Gate: Avalora reveals that Gate wounds can be healed only if living terrain is treated as ally, witness, and battlefield at once. It directly tests the faction tension: Their memory is power, but it can become vengeance when old wounds refuse to compost.
terrain: fae crossing where mirrored dew paths repeat careless movement
